Ascension hymns in Tonic Solfa

Ascension Day, forty days after Easter, remembers Jesus being taken up into heaven. Its hymns sing of Christ ascended, reigning and praying for his people. Here are the 6 hymns on NoteFusion, each with the solfa written under the words, staff notation, a piano to sing along with and a free PDF to print.
